# Fix Collector Quantity Position

## Summary
Fixed an issue where `Collector` (and `TelescopeArray.add_collector`) failed when `position` was passed as a tuple containing `astropy.Quantity` objects. The `Collector` class now converts `Quantity` positions to meters (float) internally.

## Files Modified
- `src/helios/components/collector.py`: Updated `Collector.__init__` to handle `Quantity` in `position` tuple. Updated docstring.

## Tests
- Verified with `tools/verify_fix.py` that `add_collector` accepts `(-B/2, 0)` where `B` is a Quantity.
- Confirmed internal storage is `float` (meters).
